semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Tenant-scoped idempotent receipt or payment carrying party, method, currency, source obligation and lifecycle.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Payments remain distinct records before bank reconciliation.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: AR/AP own debt; Treasury owns movement and application; Ledger owns the resulting journal.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Semantic transit account holding received, paid or provider-settled money until the bank fact confirms movement.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP bank subaccounts and Odoo outstanding or suspense accounts bridge payments and statements.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A receipt does not hit the bank directly; routing comes from governed PostingBehavior and account roles.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Editable selection of obligations and instruments awaiting independent approval and execution.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics builds vendor payment proposals before generating payments.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: The proposer cannot self-approve and execute; amount limits, signers and beneficiary changes are governed.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Provider payout that reconciles gross charges, refunds, disputes and fees to a net bank deposit.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Payment ecosystems settle batches later than the commercial charge.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: The payout batch is the bank-match unit and every component remains traceable.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Immutable imported or synchronized bank fact with source identity, account, date, amount, currency and reference.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Reconciliation systems compare bank transactions with payments, invoices and journal items.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Deduplicate on provider identity and never edit the source fact to force a match.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Auditable relation between statement lines and one or more internal movements, with splits, partials, residuals and explicit write-offs.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo applies exact, discounted and reference matches and retains remaining balances.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Matching suggestions are reversible; execution requires balanced counterparts and approval for residual write-off.

northStar.bestVersion: A universal Treasury domain where every unit of money moves from obligation or sale through an attributable payment method and clearing account into a deposit, provider settlement or bank statement, then reconciles exactly once to balanced accounting with controlled exceptions.
businessOutcomes: Explain at any moment what was sold, collected, deposited, settled, paid and reconciled.
Operate cash, banks and payment providers across countries through configuration and adapters.
Prevent unauthorized payments, duplicate movements, hidden fees and untraceable reconciliation differences.
invariants: AR/AP own obligations and Treasury owns money movement.
Bank facts and internal movements remain independently immutable.
Receipts and payments use clearing before bank confirmation.
Every movement is tenant-scoped, idempotent and attributable.
Proposal, approval, execution and acknowledgment are distinct states.
Residuals remain visible until approved resolution.
Ledger posting uses semantic roles and an outbox or saga boundary.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Payment methods, providers, bank formats, routing, clearing roles, tolerances, matching rules, approval limits and country routing validations are governed configuration; code changes only for universal lifecycle primitives or isolated connectors.

lessons.observedCapability: Bank subaccounts preserve outgoing payment-run identity until statement clearing.
lessons.lesson: Transit accounts are structural to reconciliation.
lessons.ubpDecision: Route each payment method through semantic outstanding or clearing roles before final bank posting.

lessons.observedCapability: Payment proposals select vendor obligations and bank setup before payment generation.
lessons.lesson: Selection, review, approval and execution need separate control points.
lessons.ubpDecision: Model proposals and execution independently with four-eyes approval and idempotent bank acknowledgment.

lessons.observedCapability: Statement transactions remain in suspense until matched, split or written off through explicit models.
lessons.lesson: Reconciliation is its own domain object and exception workflow.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep statements immutable, rank candidates, preserve residuals and require governed write-off.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract, capability and deterministic routing.
Require active ownership, approval, pinned revisions, fresh market evidence and resolved seeds.
Resolve ADR-0024, partial CAPAs and code anchors against the pinned UBP graph.
Require PO acceptance before treating the proposed domain boundary as committed implementation.
Require separated proposal, approval, execution and acknowledgment actors.
Require immutable deduplicated statements, splits, partials, residuals and balanced reconciliation.

enforcement.readyWhen: The expert contract, market lens and Graphify anchors validate, making Treasury an active product authority. Runtime readiness remains BLOCK while ADR-0024 is proposed, the central service is absent and cash-to-bank, payment-run and reconciliation E2E evidence do not exist.
